6514.name: The Entertainer Arcade Machine
6514.content:
The Entertainer is the perfect partner to keep your family, friends and guests entertained for hours. Arcade, music and drinks, all in the one arcade machine. The Jamma arcade machine offers 26inch LCD game play, with 2.1 subwoofer sound system that connects to your bluetooth, and 100 litre fridge. Dual power operation, commercial wheels with separate stoppers, the Entertainer is highly portable.

Move from the casual player to the hardcore gamer with the Game Wizard add-on. Boosting a 27inch gaming monitor (1ms / 144hz freesync), Sanwa joysticks and buttons, advanced control panel, and with the Highway IO board (plug and play XBOX, Playstation, Android, Raspberry Pi, Switch, and more), The Entertainer becomes a true powerhouse.

[Become A Distributor](/purchase/become-distributor-agent/)

[Purchase from Distributor](/purchase/distributors-agents/)


## ITS ARCADE!

Compatible with Jamma and upgradable to Raspberry Pi/ Game Wizard Series



## ITS MUSIC!

Bluetooth your music into The Entertainer for standalone music player



## ITS DRINKS!

Fill your 100 Litre Fridge with drinks (or food) for a complete fun package



## Options

Includes

- Advanced Control Panel
- Sanwa Joysticks and Buttons
- Highway I/O Board
- 27" Gaming Monitor (1ms /144Hz)
